title: Media never reached agents: to_media/multimodal orphaned, no asset->prompt selection, no media token accounting

rcca.root_cause: The multimodal plumbing existed but had no caller: agent_runner dropped media=, nothing selected assets for a prompt, and media bytes were never charged to the context budget.
rcca.corrective: core/media_context.py (select assets; native parts when the model accepts the modality, else bounded summary; estimate media tokens) + agent_runner threads media= and injects the summary + llm_client charges media tokens.
rcca.preventive: Fail-closed (unknown model/asset => summary/nothing); text-only/no-asset runs are a no-op; opt-in PIPELINE_MEDIA_CONTEXT (summary default); reuses asset_store/multimodal, no new store.
